name: How long does a bathroom marble installation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom marble installation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing marble in an average bathroom typically takes three to seven days, depending on the project scope and drying times. The process begins with substrate preparation, which includes checking floor joists for deflection, framing adjustments, and applying waterproof membrane systems. Setting natural stone requires white polymer-modified thin-set mortar so the adhesive does not bleed through or discolor light marble. Tiles must cure for 24 to 48 hours before grouting. After grouting, the stone needs adequate drying time before applying an initial impregnating sealer. If your remodel involves plumbing moves or custom shower pan construction, that groundwork adds extra time before tile setting begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical installation takes 3 to 7 days, allowing proper time for subfloor prep, waterproofing, thin-set curing, grouting, and stone sealing.
